replies.author: Elly
replies.body:
Hey guys,

Thanks for the warm welcome, once again! It feels great to be apart of a community that is so tight-knit and loyal to Avicus. I'd just like to let everyone know that I will be posting a formal AMA tomorrow, so it will be easier for me to respond to questions that some of you have for me.

Thanks again!
